playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

{
  "outputDir": "/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/output",
  "browser": {
    "browserName": "chromium",
    "launchOptions": {

// MONSTER MERGE — bespoke inline SVG creature art.
// Every monster is drawn from layered gradients, shapes and animated groups.

let artCounter = 0

const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v))

function defs(m, id) {
  const p = m.art.palette
  return `<defs>
    <linearGradient id="${id}-body" x1=".2" y1="0" x2=".75" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="${p.light}"/>
      <stop offset=".42" stop-color="${p.base}"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="${p.dark}"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="${id}-body2" x1=".1" y1=".1" x2=".8" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="${p.base}"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="${p.dark}"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="${id}-belly" cx=".45" cy=".3" r=".85">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="${p.belly}"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="${p.light}"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="${id}-iris" cx=".38" cy=".32" r=".8">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="${p.light}"/>
      <stop offset=".45" stop-color="${p.eye}"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="${p.dark}"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="${id}-glow" cx=".5" cy=".5" r=".5">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="${p.glow}" stop-opacity=".65"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="${p.glow}" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="${id}-accent" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="${p.light}"/>
      <stop offset=".5" stop-color="${p.accent}"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="${p.dark}"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="${id}-soft" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="${id}-glowf" x="-60%" y="-60%" width="220%" height="220%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2.6" result="b"/>
      <feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>`
}

function eye(cx, cy, m, id, fierce = false, scale = 1) {
  const p = m.art.palette
  const rx = (fierce ? 6.4 : 7.7) * scale
  const ry = (fierce ? 7.2 : 9.4) * scale
  const pupil = m.art.build === 'quad' && m.art.pose === 'drake'
    ? `<ellipse cx="${cx}" cy="${cy + 1}" rx="${2 * scale}" ry="${5.6 * scale}" fill="#1b0b2e" opacity=".75"/>`
    : `<ellipse cx="${cx}" cy="${cy + 1.4}" rx="${3 * scale}" ry="${4.6 * scale}" fill="#180d24" opacity=".8"/>`
  return `<g class="m-eyes">
    <ellipse cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" rx="${rx + 1.4}" ry="${ry + 1.4}" fill="#120a1c" opacity=".18"/>
    <ellipse cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" rx="${rx}" ry="${ry}" fill="url(#${id}-iris)"/>
    ${pupil}
    <circle cx="${cx - rx * 0.34}" cy="${cy - ry * 0.4}" r="${2.5 * scale}" fill="#fff" opacity=".95"/>
    <circle cx="${cx + rx * 0.4}" cy="${cy + ry * 0.35}" r="${1.25 * scale}" fill="#fff" opacity=".55"/>
    ${fierce
      ? `<path d="M${cx - rx - 1.6} ${cy - ry - 4.5} L${cx + rx + 1.4} ${cy - ry - 1.4}" stroke="${p.eye}" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".8"/>`
      : `<path d="M${cx - rx * 0.8} ${cy - ry - 3.6} Q${cx} ${cy - ry - 5.4} ${cx + rx * 0.8} ${cy - ry - 3.6}" fill="none" stroke="${p.dark}" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".45"/>`}
  </g>`
}

function cheek(cx, cy, m) {
  if (!m.art.cheek) return ''
  return `<ellipse cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" rx="7.5" ry="4.2" fill="${m.art.palette.accent}" opacity=".36"/>`
}

function mouth(cx, cy, m, wide = false) {
  const p = m.art.palette
  const w = wide ? 17 : 12
  if (m.art.fierce) {
    return `<path d="M${cx - w} ${cy} Q${cx} ${cy + 7} ${cx + w} ${cy}" fill="none" stroke="${p.dark}" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M${cx - 10} ${cy + 1.5} l2.5 5 l2.5 -5 Z" fill="#fff8ea"/>
      <path d="M${cx + 5} ${cy + 1.5} l2.5 5 l2.5 -5 Z" fill="#fff8ea"/>`
  }
  return `<path d="M${cx - w * 0.55} ${cy} Q${cx} ${cy + 6} ${cx + w * 0.55} ${cy}" fill="none" stroke="${p.dark}" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy + 1.4}" r="1.6" fill="${p.dark}" opacity=".7"/>`
}

function sparkles(id, coords = []) {
  return coords.map(([x, y, s = 1, o = .9], i) =>
    `<g class="m-spark" style="animation-delay:${i * .55}s" transform="translate(${x} ${y}) scale(${s})" opacity="${o}">
      <path d="M0 -7 L1.8 -1.8 L7 0 L1.8 1.8 L0 7 L-1.8 1.8 L-7 0 L-1.8 -1.8 Z" fill="${'currentColor'}"/>
    </g>`).join('')
}

function orb(cx, cy, r, color, delay = 0, opacity = .9) {
  return `<g class="m-orb" style="animation-delay:${delay}s">
    <circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${r + 3}" fill="${color}" opacity="${opacity * .18}" filter="url(#soft)"/>
    <circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${r}" fill="${color}" opacity="${opacity}"/>
    <circle cx="${cx - r * .3}" cy="${cy - r * .3}" r="${r * .32}" fill="#fff" opacity=".8"/>
  </g>`
}

// ── Quadruped: kits, wolves, bears, stags, drakes, seedlings ──────────────
function quad(m, id) {
  const a = m.art, p = a.palette, pose = a.pose, fierce = a.fierce || false
  const bear = pose === 'bear'
  const stag = pose === 'stag'
  const drake = pose === 'drake'
  const sprout = pose === 'sprout'
  const cat = pose === 'cat'
  const bodyRx = bear ? 55 : stag ? 47 : drake ? 51 : 47
  const bodyRy = bear ? 37 : 33
  const headR = bear ? 40 : drake ? 42 : stag ? 38 : 40
  const headY = bear ? 88 : 91
  const headX = 100
  const legY = 161
  const glow = a.palette.glow

  let back = ''
  // Tail (behind body)
  const tails = {
    flame: `<path d="M137 151 C166 154 181 131 169 108 C180 128 173 157 139 162 Z" fill="url(#${id}-accent)"/>
      <path d="M142 152 C160 151 170 137 163 119 C171 138 162 155 143 157 Z" fill="${p.light}" opacity=".8"/>`,
    'flame-double': `<g opacity=".95"><path d="M136 150 C160 151 173 135 165 114 C177 132 169 156 139 159 Z" fill="url(#${id}-accent)"/><path d="M144 154 C164 156 179 140 173 121 C183 142 170 162 145 162 Z" fill="${p.accent}" opacity=".8"/></g>`,
    leaf: `<g class="m-tail" style="transform-origin:140px 148px">
      <path d="M138 148 C156 150 164 136 164 124" fill="none" stroke="${p.dark}" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M158 132 C166 116 180 116 185 124 C177 134 168 138 158 132 Z" fill="${p.base}"/>
      <path d="M154 138 C158 122 170 116 179 116 C174 126 166 136 154 138 Z" fill="${p.light}" opacity=".85"/>
      <path d="M161 129 C163 121 170 117 176 118" fill="none" stroke="${p.dark}" stroke-width="1.4" opacity=".6"/>
    </g>`,
    wisp: `<g class="m-tail" style="transform-origin:140px 150px">
      <path d="M138 150 C162 155 174 139 168 121 C182 137 174 163 138 160 Z" fill="url(#${id}-body2)" opacity=".85"/>
      <path d="M145 150 C159 150 166 141 163 130 C171 142 164 156 146 155 Z" fill="${p.accent}" opacity=".28" filter="url(#${id}-soft)"/>
    </g>`,
    'drake': `<g class="m-tail" style="transform-origin:140px 148px">
      <path d="M136 146 C167 152 182 126 172 102 C182 120 176 144 160 152 C150 157 142 157 136 156 Z" fill="url(#${id}-body2)"/>
      <path d="M162 111 l8 -9 l2 12 l10 -3 l-8 12 Z" fill="${p.accent}" opacity=".9"/>
    </g>`,
    thunder: `<g class="m-tail m-glow" style="transform-origin:142px 146px">
      <path d="M142 151 L169 138 L157 133 L181 111 L160 126 L168 129 L144 148 Z" fill="${p.accent}" filter="url(#${id}-glowf)"/>
    </g>`,
    void: `<g class="m-tail" style="transform-origin:140px 148px">
      <path d="M138 150 C168 155 181 128 168 105 C184 120 180 149 156 158 C148 161 142 158 138 156 Z" fill="url(#${id}-body2)"/>
      <circle cx="172" cy="119" r="2.4" fill="${p.accent}"/><circle cx="161" cy="146" r="1.8" fill="${p.accent}"/><circle cx="179" cy="132" r="1.4" fill="#fff"/>
    </g>`
  }
  back += tails[a.tail] || tails.flame

  // Wings (behind)
  const wingShapes = {
    bat: `<path d="M98 106 C74 89 51 65 20 68 C34 84 35 95 26 111 C46 111 67 120 84 133 Z" fill="url(#${id}-body2)"/>
      <path d="M90 111 C66 101 45 86 29 78 C38 92 40 101 35 110 C52 111 69 119 82 128 Z" fill="${p.accent}" opacity=".32"/>
      <path d="M96 106 L52 72 M94 112 L43 87 M92 119 L35 104" stroke="${p.dark}" stroke-width="2.2" opacity=".55"/>`,
    water: `<path d="M98 108 C72 96 52 72 22 74 C38 89 39 101 29 116 C52 114 73 123 88 136 Z" fill="url(#${id}-body2)" opacity=".95"/>
      <path d="M91 111 C67 105 48 92 33 88 C42 99 43 107 38 114 C55 114 72 121 84 130 Z" fill="${p.accent}" opacity=".38"/>
      <path d="M96 106 C78 103 58 100 35 96 M93 114 C76 113 59 111 40 110" stroke="${p.light}" stroke-width="1.6" opacity=".55"/>`,
    leaf: `<path d="M97 107 C71 100 51 75 20 79 C35 92 37 103 28 118 C50 114 71 124 86 135 Z" fill="url(#${id}-body2)"/>
      <path d="M93 107 C69 104 49 93 31 88 C42 98 44 106 39 114 C57 113 74 120 86 129 Z" fill="${p.accent}" opacity=".36"/>
      <path d="M96 104 C74 99 54 92 33 86 M92 112 C72 110 54 108 37 108" stroke="${p.light}" stroke-width="1.8" opacity=".5"/>`,
    storm: `<path d="M98 107 C73 91 50 68 20 71 C35 86 36 97 27 113 C48 112 69 121 85 134 Z" fill="url(#${id}-body2)"/>
      <path d="M90 111 C66 103 46 90 31 83 C40 95 41 103 36 111 C53 112 70 120 83 128 Z" fill="${p.accent}" opacity=".4"/>
      <path d="M96 105 L54 76 M93 113 L43 92 M90 121 L34 110" stroke="${p.light}" stroke-width="1.6" opacity=".65"/>`,
    void: `<path d="M98 107 C73 89 49 67 18 72 C34 88 35 99 25 115 C47 113 69 122 85 135 Z" fill="url(#${id}-body2)"/>
      <path d="M90 111 C66 103 46 90 31 83 C40 95 41 103 36 111 C53 112 70 120 83 128 Z" fill="${p.accent}" opacity=".22"/>
      <circle cx="50" cy="86" r="1.6" fill="${p.accent}"/><circle cx="34" cy="101" r="1.2" fill="#fff"/><circle cx="66" cy="111" r="1.4" fill="${p.accent}"/>`
  }
  if (a.wings) {
    back = `<g class="m-wing-l" style="transform-origin:100px 108px">${wingShapes[a.wings]}</g>
      <g class="m-wing-r" style="transform-origin:100px 108px"><g transform="translate(200 0) scale(-1 1)">${wingShapes[a.wings]}</g></g>` + back
  }

  // Hind legs / feet
  const footColor = p.dark
  const legs = `
    <ellipse cx="${100 - bodyRx * .58}" cy="${legY}" rx="16" ry="12" fill="${footColor}"/>
    <ellipse cx="${100 + bodyRx * .58}" cy="${legY}" rx="16" ry="12" fill="${footColor}"/>
    <ellipse cx="${100 - bodyRx * .32}" cy="${legY + 5}" rx="13" ry="9" fill="${p.base}"/>
    <ellipse cx="${100 + bodyRx * .32}" cy="${legY + 5}" rx="13" ry="9" fill="${p.base}"/>
    <path d="M${100 - bodyRx * .72} ${legY + 3} v4 M${100 - bodyRx * .58} ${legY + 4} v4 M${100 - bodyRx * .44} ${legY + 3} v4" stroke="${p.dark}" stroke-width="1.3" opacity=".55"/>
    <path d="M${100 + bodyRx * .44} ${legY + 3} v4 M${100 + bodyRx * .58} ${legY + 4} v4 M${100 + bodyRx * .72} ${legY + 3} v4" stroke="${p.dark}" stroke-width="1.3" opacity=".55"/>
  `

  // Body
  let body = `<ellipse cx="100" cy="140" rx="${bodyRx}" ry="${bodyRy}" fill="url(#${id}-body)"/>
    <ellipse cx="100" cy="145" rx="${bodyRx * .62}" ry="${bodyRy * .58}" fill="url(#${id}-belly)" opacity=".92"/>`
  if (bear) {
    body += `<ellipse cx="58" cy="142" rx="19" ry="25" fill="url(#${id}-body2)"/>
      <ellipse cx="142" cy="142" rx="19" ry="25" fill="url(#${id}-body2)"/>
      <ellipse cx="55" cy="160" rx="12" ry="9" fill="${p.dark}"/>
      <ellipse cx="145" cy="160" rx="12" ry="9" fill="${p.dark}"/>`
  } else {
    body += `<ellipse cx="${100 - bodyRx * .66}" cy="151" rx="10" ry="14" fill="url(#${id}-body2)"/>
      <ellipse cx="${100 + bodyRx * .66}" cy="151" rx="10" ry="14" fill="url(#${id}-body2)"/>`
  }

  // Markings
  let mark = ''
  if (a.mark === 'lava' || a.mark === 'cracks') {
    mark = `<g opacity=".75" filter="url(#${id}-glowf)">
      <path d="M75 133 L86 140 L80 148 L91 153 M123 130 L114 137 L121 144 L111 149" fill="none" stroke="${p.accent}" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>

export function monsterArt(monster, { className = '', decorative = false } = {}) {
  const id = `ma${++artCounter}`
  const m = monster

  switch (m.art.build) {
    case 'bird': inner = bird(m, id); break
    case 'serpent': inner = serpent(m, id); break
    case 'wisp': inner = wisp(m, id); break
    case 'owl': inner = owl(m, id); break
    case 'shark': inner = shark(m, id); break
    case 'axolotl': inner = axolotl(m, id); break
    default: inner = quad(m, id); break
  }
  const label = decorative ? 'aria-hidden="true"' : `role="img" aria-label="${m.name} the ${m.element} monster"`
  return `<svg class="monster-art ${className}" viewBox="0 0 200 200" ${label} xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">${defs(m, id)}${inner}</svg>`
}

// MONSTER MERGE — tiny WebAudio sound engine. No external audio files needed.
class SoundEngine {
  constructor() {
    this.ctx = null
    this.master = null
    this.muted = false
    this.last = 0
  }

  init() {
    if (this.ctx) {
      if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume().catch(() => {})
      return this.ctx
    }
    const Ctx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext
    if (!Ctx) return null
    this.ctx = new Ctx()
    const comp = this.ctx.createDynamicsCompressor()
    comp.threshold.value = -18
    comp.knee.value = 22
    comp.ratio.value = 8
    comp.attack.value = 0.003
    comp.release.value = 0.25
    this.master = this.ctx.createGain()
    this.master.gain.value = this.muted ? 0 : 0.42
    this.master.connect(comp)
    comp.connect(this.ctx.destination)
    return this.ctx
  }

  setMuted(muted) {
    this.muted = muted
    if (this.master && this.ctx) {
      this.master.gain.setTargetAtTime(muted ? 0 : 0.42, this.ctx.currentTime, 0.03)
    }
  }

  tone({ freq = 440, freqEnd = null, dur = 0.14, type = 'sine', vol = 0.22, when = 0, attack = 0.005, release = null }) {
    const ctx = this.init()
    if (!ctx || this.muted) return
    const t = ctx.currentTime + when
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator()
    const gain = ctx.createGain()
    osc.type = type
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t)
    if (freqEnd) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(20, freqEnd), t + dur)
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t)
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol, t + attack)
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + (release || dur))
    osc.connect(gain)
    gain.connect(this.master)
    osc.start(t)
    osc.stop(t + dur + 0.03)
  }

  noise({ dur = 0.12, vol = 0.2, when = 0, freq = 1200, q = 0.8, type = 'bandpass', sweep = null }) {
    const ctx = this.init()
    if (!ctx || this.muted) return
    const t = ctx.currentTime + when
    const len = Math.max(1, Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate * dur))
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, len, ctx.sampleRate)
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0)
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) data[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (1 - i / len)
    const src = ctx.createBufferSource()
    src.buffer = buffer
    const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter()
    filter.type = type
    filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t)
    if (sweep) filter.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(sweep, t + dur)
    filter.Q.value = q
    const gain = ctx.createGain()
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t)
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur)
    src.connect(filter)
    filter.connect(gain)
    gain.connect(this.master)
    src.start(t)
  }

  play(name) {
    const ctx = this.init()
    if (!ctx || this.muted) return
    const now = performance.now()
    if (now - this.last < 24 && ['click', 'turn'].includes(name)) return
    this.last = now
    switch (name) {
      case 'click':
        this.tone({ freq: 640, freqEnd: 820, dur: 0.06, type: 'triangle', vol: 0.09 })
        break
      case 'tap':
        this.tone({ freq: 420, freqEnd: 300, dur: 0.09, type: 'sine', vol: 0.14 })
        break
      case 'back':
        this.tone({ freq: 380, freqEnd: 260, dur: 0.1, type: 'sine', vol: 0.12 })
        break
      case 'merge':
        [392, 494, 587, 784].forEach((f, i) => this.tone({ freq: f, dur: 0.22, type: 'triangle', vol: 0.13, when: i * 0.06 }))
        this.noise({ dur: 0.3, vol: 0.06, freq: 2600, sweep: 4800, when: 0.1 })
        break
      case 'evolve':
        this.noise({ dur: 0.6, vol: 0.08, freq: 900, sweep: 5200, type: 'highpass' })
        [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5].forEach((f, i) => this.tone({ freq: f, dur: 0.6, type: 'sine', vol: 0.12, when: i * 0.085 }))
        this.tone({ freq: 261.6, dur: 0.8, type: 'triangle', vol: 0.08, when: 0.05 })
        break
      case 'summon':
        [660, 880, 990, 1320].forEach((f, i) => this.tone({ freq: f, dur: 0.18, type: 'sine', vol: 0.08, when: i * 0.05 }))
        break
      case 'crack':
        this.noise({ dur: 0.14, vol: 0.18, freq: 1800, q: 2 })
        this.tone({ freq: 180, freqEnd: 90, dur: 0.18, type: 'square', vol: 0.08 })
        break
      case 'hit':
        this.noise({ dur: 0.16, vol: 0.16, freq: 900, sweep: 220, type: 'lowpass' })
        this.tone({ freq: 150, freqEnd: 60, dur: 0.16, type: 'sine', vol: 0.18 })
        break
      case 'crit':
        this.noise({ dur: 0.22, vol: 0.2, freq: 1600, sweep: 240, type: 'lowpass' })
        this.tone({ freq: 220, freqEnd: 70, dur: 0.22, type: 'sawtooth', vol: 0.12 })
        this.tone({ freq: 1200, dur: 0.12, type: 'triangle', vol: 0.09, when: 0.02 })
        break
      case 'magic':
        this.tone({ freq: 320, freqEnd: 900, dur: 0.28, type: 'sine', vol: 0.1 })
        this.noise({ dur: 0.25, vol: 0.05, freq: 2200, sweep: 4200, type: 'bandpass' })
        break
      case 'heal':
        [523, 659, 880].forEach((f, i) => this.tone({ freq: f, dur: 0.34, type: 'sine', vol: 0.09, when: i * 0.06 }))
        break
      case 'shield':
        this.tone({ freq: 300, freqEnd: 620, dur: 0.25, type: 'triangle', vol: 0.1 })
        this.tone({ freq: 900, dur: 0.18, type: 'sine', vol: 0.05, when: 0.06 })
        break
      case 'burn':
        this.noise({ dur: 0.24, vol: 0.07, freq: 3000, sweep: 700, type: 'bandpass' })
        break
      case 'poison':
        [220, 180, 140].forEach((f, i) => this.tone({ freq: f, dur: 0.16, type: 'sine', vol: 0.08, when: i * 0.08 }))
        break
      case 'stun':
        this.tone({ freq: 1400, freqEnd: 300, dur: 0.16, type: 'sawtooth', vol: 0.07 })
        this.noise({ dur: 0.14, vol: 0.08, freq: 3800, q: 2 })
        break
      case 'ko':
        this.tone({ freq: 300, freqEnd: 70, dur: 0.42, type: 'sawtooth', vol: 0.09 })
        this.noise({ dur: 0.3, vol: 0.06, freq: 700, sweep: 120, type: 'lowpass' })
        break
      case 'victory':
        [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5, 1318.5].forEach((f, i) => this.tone({ freq: f, dur: 0.4, type: 'triangle', vol: 0.12, when: i * 0.11 }))
        this.tone({ freq: 261.63, dur: 1.1, type: 'sine', vol: 0.08, when: 0.1 })
        this.tone({ freq: 392, dur: 1.1, type: 'sine', vol: 0.07, when: 0.1 })
        break
      case 'defeat':
        [392, 349, 293, 220].forEach((f, i) => this.tone({ freq: f, dur: 0.4, type: 'sine', vol: 0.1, when: i * 0.14 }))
        break
      case 'levelup':
        [659, 784, 1046, 1318].forEach((f, i) => this.tone({ freq: f, dur: 0.3, type: 'sine', vol: 0.09, when: i * 0.07 }))
        break
      case 'reward':
        this.tone({ freq: 1046, dur: 0.09, type: 'triangle', vol: 0.1 })
        this.tone({ freq: 1568, dur: 0.18, type: 'triangle', vol: 0.08, when: 0.07 })
        break
      case 'coin':
        this.tone({ freq: 1320, dur: 0.06, type: 'square', vol: 0.05 })
        this.tone({ freq: 1760, dur: 0.1, type: 'square', vol: 0.04, when: 0.05 })
        break
      case 'battleStart':
        this.tone({ freq: 110, freqEnd: 70, dur: 0.5, type: 'sawtooth', vol: 0.12 })
        this.noise({ dur: 0.5, vol: 0.1, freq: 400, sweep: 2400, type: 'bandpass' })
        this.tone({ freq: 392, dur: 0.25, type: 'triangle', vol: 0.1, when: 0.3 })
        this.tone({ freq: 523, dur: 0.35, type: 'triangle', vol: 0.1, when: 0.42 })
        break
      case 'turn':
        this.tone({ freq: 740, dur: 0.05, type: 'sine', vol: 0.045 })
        break
      case 'error':
        this.tone({ freq: 150, freqEnd: 110, dur: 0.18, type: 'square', vol: 0.07 })
        break
      case 'unlock':
        this.tone({ freq: 440, dur: 0.18, type: 'triangle', vol: 0.1 })
        this.tone({ freq: 660, dur: 0.3, type: 'triangle', vol: 0.1, when: 0.1 })
        break
      default:
        this.tone({ freq: 600, dur: 0.06, type: 'sine', vol: 0.07 })
    }
  }
}

## Objective
- Build a polished, fully functional monster collection/evolution game called **MONSTER MERGE** in the blank PlayGround repo, based on the attached merge-game reference image.
- Deliver 20 unique monsters, collection screen, merge/evolution, turn-based battles, distinct abilities, difficulty progression, rewards, creature animations, sound effects, and mobile-friendly UI.

## Requirements
- 20 unique monsters.
- Monster collection screen.
- Merge and evolution mechanics.
- Turn-based battles.
- Different monster abilities.
- Enemy difficulty progression.
- Reward system.
- Attractive creature animations.
- Sound effects.
- Mobile-friendly interface.
- Make collection, merging, evolution and battles fully functional.

## Decisions
- Vanilla static HTML/CSS/JS ES modules; no framework/build step, served by existing `default-start.mjs` via `index.html`.
- Five elemental families × four evolution stages = 20 monsters.
- Custom inline SVG creature art (no external sprites), with CSS idle/blink/tail/wing animations.
- WebAudio synthesized SFX, no audio files.
- localStorage save with coins/gems, levels/XP, star ranks, squad, campaign progress.
- 12-stage campaign with four bosses and escalating enemy levels.
- Merge consumes two identical copies; stages 1–3 evolve into next species, stage 4 gains star ranks.
- UI theme: enchanted dark forest/teal glass with gold accents; responsive desktop + 390×844 mobile, bottom nav.
- Downloaded and self-hosted Baloo 2 and Nunito variable fonts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected workspace and reference image (`/tmp/opencode/ref.jpg`).
- Created `index.html`, `assets/icon.svg`, fonts in `assets/fonts/`.
- Created data model: `src/data.js` with 20 monsters, abilities, campaign, themes, eggs, stat formulas.
- Created custom SVG art generator: `src/art.js` (quad/bird/serpent/wisp/owl/shark/axolotl builds, gradients, animated groups).
- Created WebAudio engine: `src/audio.js`.
- Created persistent game state/economy: `src/state.js`.
- Created CSS: `styles.css` importing `styles/base.css`, `components.css`, `screens.css`, `battle.css`, `responsive.css`.
- Created UI utilities: `src/dom.js` (icons, modals, toasts, particles, formatting).
- Created battle engine/arena UI: `src/battle.js` (turn queue, abilities/status/shields, AI, animations, victory/defeat, rewards handoff).
- Created screen renderers: `src/views.js` (home, collection, detail, merge, campaign, nest, team editor, stage preview).

### Active
- Building `src/ui.js` orchestration: navigation, event delegation, modal flows, merge/reveal/summon/reward/help/settings, battle callbacks, shell currency updates.
- Building `src/app.js` bootstrap.
- Then serve, screenshot, and debug in Chromium.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement `src/ui.js` with `init()`, hash routing for `home|collection|merge|battle|nest`, global click delegation for all `data-action` values used by `views.js`, shell currency/nav updates, toast/sound reset, and modal flows.
2. Implement `src/app.js` importing `ui.init()` and background motes; ensure `window.__MM__` debug hooks if useful.
3. Fix known issues: `state.grantEgg`/`summonEgg` should return `isNew`; add `.ui-icon` and `.depleted` CSS; patch `battle.js` destroy to resolve pending action; verify `eggArt` unique gradient IDs (currently malformed `fill="url(#egg-${''})"` in `art.js`).
4. Start server (`PORT=3000 node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-start.mjs"` or `./start.sh`) in tmux/persistent session.
5. Use `playwright-cli` to inspect all screens at 1440×900 and 390×844, console errors, and test: initial merge → evolution, auto-merge, battle actions/targeting/victory rewards, egg summon, save reload.
6. Iterate visuals and responsive fit, especially battle arena and SVG creature quality.
7. Update `README.md` with game description and run final verification; commit changes.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: app shell, nav, wallets, script entry.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data.js`: monster/ability/campaign/egg definitions and stat formulas.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/art.js`: inline SVG creature renderer.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/state.js`: save/load, merge, XP, summons, battle rewards.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/battle.js`: complete turn-based battle engine/UI.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/views.js`: all screen renderers and exported `viewState`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/dom.js`: icons, modal/toast/particle helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: synthesized sound effects.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles/base.css`: layout, tokens, topbar, world background.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles/screens.css`: home/codex/detail/merge/campaign/nest/reward styles.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles/battle.css`: arena/battle styles.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles/responsive.css`: mobile breakpoints and bottom nav.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/assets/fonts/`: Baloo 2 + Nunito woff2 and OFL licenses.
- `/tmp/opencode/ref.jpg`: user-supplied visual reference image.

## Important Context
- Repo was empty except scaffolding; all game files are new and uncommitted.
- `start.sh` runs `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`; project type is static HTML; default port 3000.
- Default capture auto-clicks buttons labeled exactly `Start`/`Play`; current UI intentionally has no such button, so capture lands on home.

- `views.js` action names currently used: `open-monster`, `filter-collection`, `go-merge`, `merge-select`, `do-merge`, `auto-merge`, `train-monster`, `toggle-team`, `open-team-editor`, `start-battle`, `open-stage`, `buy-egg`, `claim-daily`, `close-modal`.
- Battle overlay internal actions: `data-b-action`, `data-b-begin`, `data-b-auto`, `data-b-exit`, `data-b-resume`, `data-b-confirm-retreat`, `data-b-retreat`, `data-b-retry`, `data-b-claim`.
- Known bug in `art.js` `eggArt`: gradient `fill` references a malformed/random ID (`url(#egg-${''})`); fix before final visual verification.
- `state.js` `grantEgg`/`summonEgg` should expose whether a monster was new for summon/reward reveal messaging.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a polished, fully functional monster collection/evolution game called **MONSTER MERGE** in the blank PlayGround repo, based on the attached merge-game reference image.
- Deliver 20 unique monsters, collection screen, merge/evolution, turn-based battles, distinct abilities, difficulty progression, rewards, creature animations, sound effects, and mobile-friendly UI.

## Requirements
- 20 unique monsters.
- Monster collection screen.
- Merge and evolution mechanics.
- Turn-based battles.
- Different monster abilities.
- Enemy difficulty progression.
- Reward system.
- Attractive creature animations.
- Sound effects.
- Mobile-friendly interface.
- Make collection, merging, evolution and battles fully functional.

## Decisions
- Vanilla static HTML/CSS/JS ES modules; no framework/build step, served by existing `default-start.mjs` via `index.html`.
- Five elemental families × four evolution stages = 20 monsters.
- Custom inline SVG creature art (no external sprites), with CSS idle/blink/tail/wing animations.
- WebAudio synthesized SFX, no audio files.
- localStorage save with coins/gems, levels/XP, star ranks, squad, campaign progress.
- 12-stage campaign with four bosses and escalating enemy levels.
- Merge consumes two identical copies; stages 1–3 evolve into next species, stage 4 gains star ranks.
- UI theme: enchanted dark forest/teal glass with gold accents; responsive desktop + 390×844 mobile, bottom nav.
- Downloaded and self-hosted Baloo 2 and Nunito variable fonts.
- Monster detail, team editor, stage preview, merge reveal, auto-merge summary, summon reveal, battle rewards, help/settings, and reset-confirm flows all use modal overlays.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected workspace and reference image (`/tmp/opencode/ref.jpg`).
- Created `index.html`, `assets/icon.svg`, fonts in `assets/fonts/`.
- Created data model: `src/data.js` with 20 monsters, abilities, campaign, themes, eggs, stat formulas.
- Created custom SVG art generator: `src/art.js` (quad/bird/serpent/wisp/owl/shark/axolotl builds, gradients, animated groups).
- Created WebAudio engine: `src/audio.js`.
- Created persistent game state/economy: `src/state.js`.
- Created CSS: `styles.css` importing `styles/base.css`, `components.css`, `screens.css`, `battle.css`, `responsive.css`.
- Created UI utilities: `src/dom.js` (icons, modals, toasts, particles, formatting).
- Created battle engine/arena UI: `src/battle.js` (turn queue, abilities/status/shields, AI, animations, victory/defeat, rewards handoff).
- Created screen renderers: `src/views.js` (home, collection, detail, merge, campaign, nest, team editor, stage preview).
- Implemented `src/ui.js`: hash routing (`#/home`, `#/collection`, `#/merge`, `#/battle`, `#/nest`), global event delegation, shell currency/nav/sound updates, detail/team/stage/help modals, merge + auto-merge reveal flows, training/team toggles, battle start/reward handoff, egg summon/crack/reveal flow, daily gift, settings, reset flow, ambient motes, `window.__MM__` debug surface.
- Implemented `src/app.js` bootstrap with DOM-ready handling and error fallback.
- Fixed critical `document.body.dataset.view` bug that caused every `[data-action]` click to be intercepted as navigation; changed to `data-screen` and guarded against body in `onClick`.
- Fixed `src/audio.js` ASI bug: `[523.25, ...].forEach` after `this.noise(...)` now prefixed with `;`.
- Fixed `src/art.js` syntax error in `axolotl` tail (removed stray `}`).
- Fixed malformed `eggArt` gradient IDs; now uses generated `${id}` and `${id}-shine`.
- Added `isNew` returns from `addMonster`, `summonEgg`, `grantEgg`.
- Fixed `battle.js` `destroy()` to resolve a pending player action before teardown.
- Added CSS for `.ui-icon`, `.view-enter`, wallet bumps, `.depleted` cards, setting-row hover, modal close positioning, reward art sizing.
- Improved HP bars (`height: 11px`, white text with shadow), and `.ch-rec small` now block with margin.
- Verified home, collection, merge, merge reveal, auto-merge summary, nest, summon reveal, campaign, battle intro/turn, victory and battle rewards at 1440×900 and several mobile screens; console generally clean after fixes.
- Tested actual merge, auto-merge, egg summon, daily/economy updates, battle victory and reward claim; save state persisted through reloads.

### Active
- Final visual/functional polish and verification across all screens at desktop + mobile.
- Need to verify stage-2 battle on mobile after recent CSS changes, especially battle HP text, arena fit, action bar, result/reward overlays.
- Need to verify reward modal scrollbar artifact is gone after CSS `reward-rays` inset fix (`inset: 0`) with a fresh reload.
- Need to test mobile home/collection/merge/nest modals after all CSS/JS fixes.
- Need to verify target selection, Guard, abilities, defeat/retry/retreat, team editor toggles, help toggles, reset flow, and save reload.
- Need to update `README.md` and commit.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Finish mobile battle check (begin battle, strike/ability/guard, target switch, victory reward, defeat/retry/retreat).
2. Reload fresh at both 1440×900 and 390×844; capture all screens and modals; inspect console for errors.
3. Verify no overflow/scrollbar artifacts in reward/auto-merge/summon modals; verify `.reward-rays` computed inset is now `0`.
4. Improve known rough edges: mobile campaign toolbar (`.campaign-toolbar` / `.ct-squad` wrapping, tiny progress bar), mobile filter row hint/fade if needed, battle player-row spacing/clipping, stage-enemy line wrapping.
5. Test help/settings (sound toggle, auto toggle, reset confirm) and team editor team changes.
6. Update `README.md` with game description, controls, and run instructions.
7. Final regression pass; check git diff; commit all uncommitted game files.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js`: routing, event delegation, modals, all game flows.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/app.js`: bootstrap entry.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/views.js`: home/collection/detail/merge/campaign/nest/team/stage renderers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/battle.js`: turn engine, arena DOM, actions, victory/defeat, rewards.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/state.js`: save/load, economy, merge, summon, XP, battle rewards.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data.js`: 20 monsters, abilities, campaign, eggs, stat formulas.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/art.js`: SVG creature/egg art renderer.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/dom.js`: icons, modal/toast/particle helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: synthesized sound engine.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles/screens.css`: home/codex/detail/merge/campaign/nest/reward/summon/help styles.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles/battle.css`: arena/battle styles and HP bars.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles/components.css`: shared components + recent UI glue.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles/responsive.css`: mobile breakpoints and bottom nav.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: app shell, nav, wallets.
- `/tmp/opencode/shots/`: latest screenshots (desktop and mobile).

## Important Context
- Server is running in tmux session `mm` on `http://localhost:3000` via `PORT=3000 node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-start.mjs"`.

- All game files are new/uncommitted; repo was essentially scaffolding at start.

- `start.sh` runs `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`; default port 3000.
- Default capture auto-clicks buttons labeled exactly `Start`/`Play`; current UI intentionally has no such button, so capture lands on home.
- Reward-card scrollbar artifact was caused by `reward-rays` with `inset: -50%`; CSS changed to `inset: 0`, but the browser must be reloaded (not just SPA navigated) for verification.
- `window.__MM__` exposes `state`, `view`, `navigate`, `render`, `merge`, `autoMerge`, `summon`, `battle`, `openMonster`, `reset` for debugging.
- Known minor UI polish items: mobile campaign toolbar wraps awkwardly; mobile filter row clips later element chips; battle player units sit close to action bar; battle result overlay appears ~700ms after KO.
